episodes.title: Casa Milà - La Pedrera
episodes.summary: When a magnate is kidnapped and burned on the balcony of an iconic Barcelona building, a disgraced police officer must return to work the case.

episodes.title: Palau Güell
episodes.summary: As another public figure goes missing under troubling circumstances, Milo and Rebecca fear the worst, while a journalist is hungry to break the story.

episodes.title: Cripta de la Colònia Güell
episodes.summary: Mauricio receives a mysterious call as the police identify their first suspect. Singla tries to dissuade Rebeca from working with Milo.

episodes.title: Parc Güell
episodes.summary: The discovery of another burned body at Parc Güell confirms Milo and Rebeca's instincts. As pressure mounts, Mauricio's footage comes under scrutiny.

episodes.title: Pabellones Güell
episodes.summary: Milo struggles as the case takes a shocking and tragic turn. The killer asks to meet Mauricio again — but first he must lose the cops on his tail.

episodes.title: Sagrada Familia
episodes.summary: As the Pope's visit draws near, Mauricio's phone points to his source. Milo and Rebeca race to stop tragedy from striking at the Sagrada Família.
